name: mbrowser_open
description: Open a URL in a BACKGROUND tab of the user's real Chrome (their visible tab does not change). Returns a tab id used by the other mbrowser tools. Set visible=true to bring the tab to the front so the user can watch the interaction.

visible.description: Bring the tab to the front (default false = background, no visible change).

name: mbrowser_snapshot
description: Return an indexed list of the interactive elements on the current (or given) tab: [{i, tag, role, text, href, placeholder, value}]. Use the index with mbrowser_click/mbrowser_type as "@<i>" instead of guessing CSS selectors.

tab_id.description: Tab id. Omit for the last opened tab.

name: mbrowser_tabs
description: List every open tab of the user's Chrome with its id, title, URL, and whether mbrowser owns it.

name: mbrowser_read
description: Read the current (or given) tab: title, URL, and page text (default), HTML, or title only. Works while the tab stays in the background.

tab_id.description: Tab id from mbrowser_open. Omit to use the last opened tab.

name: mbrowser_js
description: Evaluate JavaScript in the current (or given) tab and return the value. Use it to extract structured data from the DOM.

tab_id.description: Tab id. Omit for the last opened tab.

name: mbrowser_click
description: Click an element in the current (or given) tab. Pass "@<i>" from mbrowser_snapshot (preferred) or a CSS selector. Shows an animated cursor overlay before clicking.

tab_id.description: Tab id. Omit for the last opened tab.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click.

name: mbrowser_type
description: Focus an element and type text into it (real input events). Pass "@<i>" from mbrowser_snapshot (preferred) or a CSS selector. Shows the animated cursor overlay.

tab_id.description: Tab id. Omit for the last opened tab.

name: mbrowser_wait
description: Wait until an element matching a CSS selector exists in the current (or given) tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id. Omit for the last opened tab.

name: mbrowser_shot
description: Capture a PNG screenshot of the current (or given) tab to a file path.

tab_id.description: Tab id. Omit for the last opened tab.

path.description: Absolute file path for the PNG.

name: mbrowser_close
description: Close a tab that mbrowser opened (never one of the user's own tabs).

tab_id.description: Tab id. Omit to close the last opened tab.
